title: Vitess: remove a tablet from a shard (DeleteTablets + stop services)
description: Runs `nexus scale-out remove vitess vitess-shard2-tablet-3`: stops vttablet+mysqld and DeleteTablets from the topo. PRIMARY-guarded + a >=2-surviving-tablet floor.

observe.what: removed vitess-shard2-tablet-3 (nexus-202) from commerce/80- in ~12s; topo record deleted; re-add via scale-out add --shard 80-

whatProves: VitessAdapter.ScaleOutRemoveAsync stops the tablet services then DeleteTablets the alias from the topo, refusing a PRIMARY and refusing to drop the shard below 2 surviving tablets.
